gate.each_half: observed statistic strictly exceeds its own class-preserving permutation95th percentile

roles: Only each existing source trajectory four TRAIN users. Exclude its diagnostic held and cyclic validation user; users1/2 never read as signal. Metadata labels used only to define roles and known quality mask.
sampling: Intersection of labels present in all four training users; exactly48 per user/class drawn independently of signals from fixed RNG; first24 half0 and next24 half1. Same subset all epochs; absent HV6 class3 never imputed.
checkpoint: Each epoch segment average, not epoch-end weights; eval mode disables dropout. Last linear head only, features extracted from fixed pretrained source model.
statistic: Float64 per-example unnormalized CE head gradients; each domain population variance, equal-domain/coordinate squared deviation from average variance. Variance moments checked against independent centered calculation.
null: 99 permutations of user labels WITHIN each class independently for full/half0/half1; each class-user count preserved. Exceedance fraction (1+count(null>=observed))/100. Conditional descriptive noise calibration, not independent hypothesis-test p-value.
stability: Cosine between domain-centered variance matrices from two disjoint stratified halves. Full ratio/exceedance and both half>own null95 plus cosine>=.5 required at both epochs1 and6 per trajectory. Epoch24 descriptive only; no substitute timepoint.
decision: At least4/6 qualifying trajectories permits designing a separately preregistered intervention; does not establish effectiveness or novelty. On failure stop this gradient-variance mismatch rationale; no coordinate/user/epoch/threshold/seed search.
limits: Six trajectories share training users and fitted samples; not independent replications.
Conditional permutations do not model the adaptive training procedure; descriptive mechanism screen only.

Common-class equal-user sampling differs from original empirical risk.
lambda1000 penalty/CE ratio only reported as a reference magnitude, never selected or used to train.
